practice_observation: Keep: a coordinator-owned criteria file with recorded revisions, plus an acceptance suite from a separate author. Neither the implementer nor the reviewer could quietly redefine done. The suite and the review together drove six criteria clarifications, and one weakening proposal was rejected. Keep a higher-tier independent reviewer: Opus found two High gate-semantics defects that the same-tier acceptance suite did not catch. Observed failure: for this outcome, Codex Terra under agentops dispatch run did not deliver. The first attempt escalated on a workspace deletion policy. The second ran out of its tool execution window on a multi-minute render and returned outcome 'done' for incomplete work. Read the worker's final message, not the status outcome field, before treating a run as complete. A Claude Sonnet subagent, with renders run in the background, delivered in one pass plus one repair round. This is a single outcome, so it is not a comparative model-quality claim. Long acceptance runs (about 35 min) need detached execution that survives a session restart.
